title: Darius of the first race
summary: Raleigh names Darius of the first race in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Darius, named in Reineccius his first race of the Achaemenidae, between Achaemenes and Cyrus the first of that name. He is not Darius the Mede, not Darius the sonne of Hystaspes, and not the Darius whom Alexander conquered. The one-word title would fold onto those records, so the title is five words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
